2 بهّج , (ISd, L,) inf. n. تَبْهِيجٌ, (K,) He beautified; rendered beautiful, or goodly. (ISd, L, K.) ISd says, I have not heard this, except in the saying of El-'Ajjáj, “دَعْ ذَا وَبَهِّجْ حَسَبًا مُبَهَّجَا
” as though meaning [Leave thou this subject, and] beautify, or adorn, the more this nobility [already beautified, or adorned,] by thy describing it. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
